modelspec.checkpoint.DType.title: DType
modelspec.checkpoint.DType.description: A tensor element type and its size in bytes; `f32` for every value, `i32` only for row ids an `embedding` reads, never a parameter or a checkpoint tensor (DESIGN.md § 2.2).

modelspec.checkpoint.Shape.title: Shape
modelspec.checkpoint.Shape.description: A tensor shape; each dimension is a positive integer and rank 0 is a scalar (DESIGN.md § 2.2).

modelspec.observatory.GraphNode.title: GraphNode
modelspec.observatory.GraphNode.description: One operator of the graph and the tensor it defines, with its dtype and shape (DESIGN.md § 3.1, every tensor value has a shape, dtype and defining operation).

value_id.description: The SSA value the node defines, as Tensor IR prints it (DESIGN.md § 3.2 ValueId).

subgraph.description: Present exactly on a node of a Training-stage graph, so forward and backward are told apart (epic:training-observatory).

modelspec.observatory.Subgraph.title: Subgraph
modelspec.observatory.Subgraph.description: The Training IR subgraph of a node; Gradient is the backward computation (DESIGN.md § 3.1; `Subgraph` in `modelspec-core/src/ir/training.rs`).

modelspec.observatory.TensorOperator.title: TensorOperator
modelspec.observatory.TensorOperator.description: The Tensor IR operations, ReluGrad, BroadcastScalar, EmbeddingGrad, SumRows, GeluGrad, LayerNormGradX, LayerNormGradGamma, SoftmaxGrad, AttentionGradQ, AttentionGradK, AttentionGradV, CrossEntropyGrad, DropoutGrad and SigregColumnsGrad being internal gradient ops, StopGradient a source op that the pass after autodiff removes so that no training step holds it, Sqrt and Div internal ops of the optimizer subgraph of an AdamW step, SigregColumns the internal op that sigreg lowers to, and Sigreg the source operator, which no verified program holds (DESIGN.md § 3.1, § 4; `TensorOp` in `modelspec-core/src/ir/tensor.rs`). The operators of epic:bert-from-scratch join as the compiler gains them.
